# Data import

Setup:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycollo)
library(udpipe)
library(data.tree)


```

We don't need to change `comboDF`, fortunately! So let's just import it.

```{r}
load("1_extract_measures.Rdata")
```

# Getting a DF of combinations

```{r}
getCombos = function(alpha){
  measures_adv_root = getMeasures(combosDF, c("dc", "root"), c("dc", "root"), doc_id = "docID")
  
  measures_adv_root_df = measures_adv_root$results
  measures_adv_root_df = measures_adv_root_df %>%
    mutate(p_fisher_yates_1tail = case_when(
      or > 1 ~ p_fisher_yates / 2,
      T ~ 1 - p_fisher_yates / 2))
  
  by = getBenjaminiYekutieli(measures_adv_root_df$p_fisher_yates_1tail, alpha = alpha)
  measures_adv_root_df = measures_adv_root_df %>%
    mutate(p_fisher_yates_reject = by$reject)
  View(measures_adv_root_df %>% filter(!is.na(root) & !is.na(dc)) %>% arrange(p_fisher_yates_1tail))
  measures_adv_root_df %>% select(root, dc, n, f_dc_not_root, f_root_not_dc, f_not_root_or_dc, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail) %>% View
  measures_adv_root_df %>% filter(!is.na(root), !is.na(dc), p_fisher_yates_reject) %>% select(root, dc, n, f_dc_not_root, f_root_not_dc, f_not_root_or_dc, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail, p_fisher_yates_reject) %>% View
  
  measures_adv_root_df %>% filter(!is.na(root), !is.na(dc), p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm < .99) %>% select(root, dc, n, f_dc_not_root, f_root_not_dc, f_not_root_or_dc, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail, p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm, pmi) %>% arrange(pmi) %>% View
    
  selected_adv_root_df = measures_adv_root_df %>% filter(!is.na(root), !is.na(dc), p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm < .99)
  
  combosDF_poststep1 = combosDF %>%
    left_join(measures_adv_root_df, by = c("dc", "root")) %>%
    mutate(advv = case_when(
      p_fisher_yates_reject & !is.na(dc) ~ paste(dc, root, sep = "_"),
      T ~ root))
  
  measures_advv_sfp = getMeasures(combosDF_poststep1, c("advv", "sfp"), c("advv", "sfp"), doc_id = "docID")
  
  measures_advv_sfp_df = measures_advv_sfp$results
  
  
  measures_advv_sfp_df = measures_advv_sfp_df %>%
    mutate(p_fisher_yates_1tail = case_when(
      or > 1 ~ p_fisher_yates / 2,
      T ~ 1 - p_fisher_yates / 2))
  
  by = getBenjaminiYekutieli(measures_advv_sfp_df$p_fisher_yates_1tail, alpha = alpha)
  measures_advv_sfp_df = measures_advv_sfp_df %>%
    mutate(p_fisher_yates_reject = by$reject)
  View(measures_advv_sfp_df %>% filter(!is.na(sfp) & !is.na(advv)) %>% arrange(p_fisher_yates_1tail))
  measures_advv_sfp_df %>% select(sfp, advv, n, f_advv_not_sfp, f_sfp_not_advv, f_not_sfp_or_advv, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail) %>% View
  measures_advv_sfp_df %>% filter(!is.na(sfp), !is.na(advv), p_fisher_yates_reject) %>% select(sfp, advv, n, f_advv_not_sfp, f_sfp_not_advv, f_not_sfp_or_advv, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail, p_fisher_yates_reject) %>% View
  
  measures_advv_sfp_df %>% filter(!is.na(sfp), !is.na(advv), p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm < .99) %>% select(sfp, advv, n, f_advv_not_sfp, f_sfp_not_advv, f_not_sfp_or_advv, or, p_fisher_yates, p_fisher_yates_1tail, p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm, pmi) %>% arrange(pmi) %>% View
    
  selected_advv_sfp_df = measures_advv_sfp_df %>% filter(!is.na(sfp), !is.na(advv), p_fisher_yates_reject, DP_norm < .99)
  
  selected_advv_sfp_df = selected_advv_sfp_df %>%
    mutate(
      dc = case_when(str_detect(advv, "_") ~ sapply(strsplit(advv, "_"), function(x) x[1]),
                     T ~ ""),
      root = case_when(str_detect(advv, "_") ~ sapply(strsplit(selected_advv_sfp_df$advv, "_"), function(x) x[length(x)]),
                      T ~ "")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      dc = na_if(dc, ""),
      root = na_if(root, "")
    )
  final_pairs = selected_advv_sfp_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(dc) & !is.na(sfp)) %>%
    group_by(dc, sfp) %>%
    count
  write_excel_csv(final_pairs, paste0("final_pairs_", alpha, ".csv"))
  final_pairs
}

pairs_.2 = getCombos(.2)
pairs_.1 = getCombos(.1)
pairs_.05 = getCombos(.05)
```
# Exploring results

selectedDF_exp2.05_exp3_comparison = pairs_.05 %>%
